entities.summary: The Gonbad Kabud Mosque, also known as the Kabud Gonbad Mosque and the Naderi Mosque, is a mosque located in Kalat, in the Kalat County, Razavi Khorasan province, Iran. The mosque structure dates from the Seljuk and Afsharid periods, and was renovated during the Qajar era.
